Definition: from G4253 and G2233; to lead the way for others, i.e. show deference:--prefer.
BiblicalUsage: Proegeomai means to lead the way for others, to prefer, to show deference. Paul uses it once: be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love, in honour preferring one another.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that honour given away is honour multiplied, and the church that prefers one another is the church that looks like Christ.
